New Tulu or mixed messages use the cloud teacher. Approved Tulu phrases work offline.

This switch controls speech recognition. English uses your enabled cloud teacher or the local Kannada model. Captions are not saved.
Ready. Tap Start and speak Kannada.
Your Kannada captions will appear here.
Microphone audio only; other apps must play through the speaker. Recognition uses Kannada and may mishear Tulu. Float keeps captions visible; closing stops listening.
On-device speech is unavailable. Enable online recognition to try your phone’s speech service.
No speech service found. Enable or install a speech recognition service in Android settings.
Microphone permission is needed. Tap Start to allow it, or enable Microphone in Android app settings.

Speech recognition could not connect. Check your connection and tap Start.
The speech service is busy. Close other microphone apps and tap Start.
Speech recognition stopped. Check your phone’s speech service and tap Start to retry.
No speech heard. Tap Start when you are ready.
